name: quick-batch-renamer
description: 人人都能用的小体积跨平台文件批量重命名桌面工具

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron . --renderer-url=http://127.0.0.1:5173"
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs && esbuild electron/preload.cts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.build:electron-app: tsc -b && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.copy:tauri:win: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const out='release';fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});const source=path.join('src-tauri','target','release','quick-batch-renamer.exe');const target=path.join(out,'快捷批量重命名.exe');if(fs.existsSync(target)){const backupDir=path.join(out,'backup');fs.mkdirSync(backupDir,{recursive:true});const stamp=new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');fs.copyFileSync(target,path.join(backupDir,'快捷批量重命名-windows-before-copy-'+stamp+'.exe'));}fs.copyFileSync(source,target);console.log(target);"
scripts.dist:tauri:win: tauri build --bundles nsis && npm run copy:tauri:win
